method: Each original-language claim, request and derived-claim quotation was matched against extracted text from the stated physical page of the primary PDF, normalising line breaks and line-end word hyphenation only. This supplements visual reading; it is not an independent substantive review.
results: All claim/request quotation fragments matched the cited page; every underline is an exact substring; each submission’s combined quoted fragments are below 25 words.
scope_limit: Does not automatically validate translations, legal reasoning, whether a counterexample is representative, or the evidence sufficiency of a finding.
